note: County-owned 17-acre multi-use park on the east side of Lincoln just off MT-200 (pavilion, playground, ball fields; concerts and markets), with a seasonal campground in the trees: ~8 pull-through electric sites plus ~20 non-hookup sites. Electric ~$30, non-hookup ~$20. Everything in town within walking distance. --Claude
summary: Lincoln Valley Chamber's park page (the entry's website; no county page found): confirmed FCFS with a fee, electric and non-electric sites, showers, seasonal host; season changed from derived 'not year-round' to May through October (opens 05-01, closes 10-31). Not stated: amperage, site counts, water/sewer, toilet types, fees (left as derived/note). Note: dropped 'typically closes late Sept' (the page says May through October) and the restated FCFS/facilities.
